latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of subtitles-from-video: generate and embed subtitles in videos easily via cloud processing.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB for automatic English subtitle generation and burned-in captions.
- No manual transcription or complex software required; returns captioned video in 30-60 seconds.
- Seamless setup: automatic backend token creation and session handling (100 free credits, 7-day expiry).
- Integrated action handling for upload, export, credits, and session status with user-friendly responses and error messages.
- Supports batch and iterative workflows; draft timeline can be previewed and refined before export.
- Clear documentation on supported formats, limits, error handling, and best practices for accurate, fast results.
